title: Toward an exotic $S^2\times S^2$ and an exotic $\mathbb{CP}^2\#\overline{\mathbb{CP}}^2$
summary: We study a specified Luttinger filling in the construction of Lidman and Piccirillo whose simple connectivity would yield exotic $S^2\times S^2$ and $\mathbb{CP}^2\#\overline{\mathbb{CP}}^2$. An earlier version of this manuscript claimed simple connectivity from incorrectly derived group relations; that claim is withdrawn. We derive the complete fundamental-group presentation and express the group as a one-relator quotient of an iterated HNN extension containing the genus-two surface group. The filled group is trivial exactly when the final relation kills a specified fiber commutator. We…
